attempts.summary: Built a WireGuard site-to-site tunnel between node1 (VyOS) and node2 (OPNsense) joining node3's private network (10.0.1.0/24) and node4's private network (10.0.2.0/24). Discovered the real topology by ARP-probing each spare NIC: node1.eth1<->node2.vtnet1 is the transit link, node1.eth2<->node3.enp8s0 is private-A, node2.vtnet2<->node4.enp8s0 is private-B. Configured VyOS natively (interfaces, wireguard peer, static route, commit+save) and OPNsense via config.xml surgery (opt1/opt2/opt3 interface assignment, WireGuard server/client model, filter pass rules) plus a boot-time rc.syshook fixup script working around an OPNsense wg-service-control bug that failed to auto-apply the tunnel address/peer routes. Configured node3/node4 private addressing and cross-subnet static routes via NetworkManager (raw ip commands were reverted by NM's reconciler). Verified node3 and node4 reach each other by private address with only encrypted UDP/51820 crossing the transit link. Restarted all four nodes one at a time, confirmed boot-id/uptime changes on each, and re-verified the tunnel and end-to-end connectivity recovered automatically after every restart.
